title: Jeevana Chaitra
desc: A man discovers that alcohol is a major problem in the villages. Men buy alcohol with the minimal money they have and do not work, while the wives and children get neglected and abused.

title: Simple Agi Ondh Love Story
desc: Rachana persuades her brother to meet her boyfriend's sister, hoping that cupid will strike. However, things take an unexpected turn when another girl tricks him into falling in love with her.

title: Majili
desc: Poorna, an aspiring cricketer, falls into a deep depression after being abandoned by his lover, Anshu. Despite this, he is forced to marry his neighbour Sravani, who secretly has feelings for him.

title: Maanaadu
desc: A man is pulled into a plot to assassinate a chief minister at a political rally. However, he soon realises that he is trapped in a time loop with a police officer.

title: Aakash
desc: While working odd jobs, Aakash, a practical man, meets Nandini, a rich girl, who falls for him, but he does not reciprocate. However, her brothers misunderstand their bond and make his life hell.
